# Team Dunk

> Team Dunk Corporation is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit empowering youth through basketball, mentorship, creative storytelling, music and community programs.

## Key pages
- [About Team Dunk](https://www.teamdunk.net/about/): Mission, values and co-founders Alico Dunk and Simone Harris.
- [Team Dunk Ghana](https://www.teamdunk.net/team-dunk-ghana/): Real-world Ghana youth basketball and leadership initiative.
- [Programs](https://www.teamdunk.net/programs/): Basketball clinics, mentorship, workshops and creative learning.
- [Dunkiverse](https://www.teamdunk.net/dunkiverse/): Separate fictional Roblox learning and adventure experience.
- [Blog](https://www.teamdunk.net/blog/): Stories about youth development, Ghana, basketball and creativity.
- [Contact](https://www.teamdunk.net/contact/): Partnerships, volunteering and program enquiries.

## Important distinction
Team Dunk Ghana is a real-world youth-development initiative. The Dunkiverse is a separate fictional Roblox experience.
